# CommanderBG

> CommanderBG (https://commanderbg.com) is a free browser game site with two modes: Commander, a daily strategy puzzle, and the Battleground, a live Red vs Blue territory map.

## Commander — the daily strategy puzzle
- A new map every day at midnight Mountain Time; everyone gets the same map.
- Difficulty follows the week: Monday easiest, Friday and Saturday hardest, Sunday medium.
- Your Commander holds the 3×3 around it. You place Archers (take 3 squares left and right; fly over walls and water; trees stop them) and Soldiers (take 2 squares up and down; walk through trees and wade water; walls stop them).
- Troops can only stand on ground you already hold, so the order you place them is the puzzle.
- Practice freely; one submission counts. After submitting you see your rank, the score distribution, and the best possible layout.
- Free, no download. An email is only needed to post a score.

## The Battleground
- Red vs Blue on one shared live map. Players take squares for their side; the first square is free.
- Good Commander scores earn free squares on the Battleground.
